# kvindo_kafka_topic (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kvindo_kafka" "main" {
  name = "main"
}

resource "kvindo_kafka_topic" "orders" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "orders"
    folder_id = data.kvindo_kafka.main.metadata.folder_id
  }
  spec = {
    kafka_id   = data.kvindo_kafka.main.metadata.id
    partitions = 6

    # Omit to keep the topic's existing factor, or to take the cluster default on create.
    # Set it only to pin an explicit value - sending 1 is a real request for a single replica,
    # not a way to say "unset".
    # replication_factor = 3

    config = {
      "retention.ms" = "604800000"
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Optional:

- `config` (Map of String)
- `kafka_id` (String) The cluster this topic lives in. Immutable - a topic cannot move between clusters.
- `partitions` (Number) Partition count. Increase-only: Kafka has no partition-decrease operation, so a reduction is rejected rather than silently ignored.
- `replication_factor` (Number) OMIT this to let the platform resolve it - on create it takes the cluster's effective `default.replication.factor` (`min(3, broker count)` unless overridden), and on a later apply it keeps the topic's current factor. Sending `1` is NOT a way to say unset: it is an explicit request that pins the topic to a single replica, which on a 3-broker cluster silently removes all fault tolerance. An explicit value must be 1..broker count; exceeding it is rejected ASYNCHRONOUSLY by the service when it applies the change, so the failure appears on the request, not as a plan-time or submit-time error. Immutable once set.
